recipes.name: Vegan Butter 'Chicken' with Baked Tofu
instructions: ﻿﻿Soak the raw cashews in boiling water to soften. Set aside.
﻿﻿Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C)*.
﻿﻿Add all the baked tofu ingredients to a large bowl and mix.
﻿﻿Transfer to the baking tray and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring once or twice. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning.
﻿﻿Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large pot over high heat. Cook the onion, garlic, jalapeño, and ginger until lightly golden.
﻿﻿Add in the spices and cook for 1 more minute, stirring throughout to toast them.
﻿﻿Then add the remaining curry ingredients, including the drained cashews.
﻿﻿Blend everything using an immersion blender or transfer to a standing blender to blend until smooth. Let simmer over low, and cover with a lid.
﻿﻿Once the tofu is golden, remove it from the oven and add it to the pot. Give it a gentle stir.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † One (14.5 oz / 410g) can diced tomatoes yields about 1⅔ cups. † One (13.5 oz / 400ml) can yields about about 1⅔ cups. * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
